newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Investment Bank's US$100 mln FRN allotted.
newsitem.headline: China Investment Bank's US$100 mln FRN allotted.

text.p: China Investment Bank's US$100 million floating rate note issue has been closed, lead manager Chase Manhattan Asia said on Thursday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with no put or call options. The issue was priced and re-offered at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong, Chase Manhattan Asia, Daiwa Securities Hong Kong, HSBC Markets and Standard Chartered Bank are lead managers.
DBS, LTCB Asia, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley and UBS are co-lead managers.
BNP, Commerzbank Singapore, Fuji International Finance Hong Kong, Sanwa International Finance and Societe Generale Asia are co-managers.
